title: The record branch's one-writer guard also refuses a lane's write made through the GitHub file tools
why: Lane archive-flow wrote step archive-batch-check to the roadmap branch through the GitHub MCP file tool (b10482fb2, 10:30 CST Nov 12), around the one-writer rule; the guard reads only git pushes.
note: Guard, code. Harm: two writers on the record branch race, and the write skips the roadmap.html build (b10482fb2 changed the step file only). Ready, no lane.
